english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an airplane.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for an aircraft, especially an ordinary plane or helicopter.

examples.english: We’re taking a plane to Taipei.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 fei1 gei1 heoi3 toi4 bak1

examples.english: The aircraft is about to land.
examples.jyutping: gaa3 fei1 gei1 zau6 faai3 gong3 lok6 laa3
